description: Removes members from a Sitecore role.

identity.description: The identity of the role to remove members from (e.g. 'CustomRole' or full path 'sitecore\CustomRole')

members.description: The members to remove from the role (comma-separated list of users or roles, e.g. 'sitecore\user1,sitecore\user2')

name: security-remove-role-member
